name: Ashwall Grip-Null Secondskin Glove
description:
Matte charcoal-grey gloves in ultra-thin second-skin silicone-over-mesh construction, cut to mid-wrist. The outer surface is micro-textured for gecko-style dry adhesion on glass, polymer, and lacquered steel. The inner surface is lined with a print-suppression membrane that disrupts friction-ridge contact at the molecular level — no latent prints, no partial impressions.

Four fingers are full-coverage; the thumb has a split-tip option for fine tool manipulation. Seams are internally bonded rather than stitched, leaving no exterior thread lines. The gloves compress to pocket-size. Street-label — no branding, no packaging.
functionality: Gecko-texture dorsal and palm grip enables adhesion on smooth vertical surfaces up to bodyweight load. Print-suppression membrane eliminates friction-ridge transfer. Split-tip thumb option allows fine manipulation without full removal. Compresses to 40mm roll for pocket carry.
what_it_says: Someone who goes places they aren't invited and leaves no trace they were ever there.
story_hooks: A print recovered at a high-profile Spire break-in matches no database — but the glove pattern left in the adhesive residue is unmistakably Ashwall.
The same street fabricator who makes Ashwall gloves is being pressured by a corponation security division to embed a tracker in the next run.
A pair is found on a Shelf kid who couldn't possibly afford them — who gave them the gloves, and what job are they being set up for?
related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Gecko Ascender GA-4

physical_description.visual_profile: Form-fitting second-skin gloves that cling to the hand like a shadow. Minimal visual presence — almost invisible when worn, creating an impression of bare skin with a subtle grey overlay. Sleek, utilitarian, purposefully unmarked. The wearer appears augmented at the fingertips without visible chrome or bulk.
physical_description.fit: Compression fit, engineered to conform to individual hand geometry. Tight enough to maintain adhesion function, loose enough at the wrist to roll down and pocket. Mid-wrist cut exposes the lower forearm.
physical_description.primary_material: Ultra-thin silicone composite bonded to breathable mesh substrate. Print-suppression polymer lining on palm and finger contact zones.
physical_description.texture: Outer surface: micro-textured, matte, finely granular to the eye — resembles gecko foot structure at 0.5mm scale. Inner surface: molecular-smooth, chemically treated to prevent friction-ridge transfer. Overall tactile impression is slippery and controlled simultaneously.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte charcoal grey monochromatic. No accent colors, no patterns. Deliberately featureless. Slight variation in sheen between textured outer and smooth inner visible only in direct light.
physical_description.closures: None. Friction-fit compression closure — the glove stretches over the hand and locks in place via elastic recovery of the silicone blend. Thumb split-tip secured via internal bonded seam, folds inward when not in use.
distinctive_features: Gecko-texture micro-adhesion outer surface for glass and polymer grip without glue or suction
Molecular print-suppression lining — no forensic trace signature
Internal bonded seams, zero exterior stitching for minimal profile and durability
Split-tip thumb design for precision work — folds flat or extends for tool manipulation
Compressible to pocket-size when removed, rolls into tight bundle
Unlicensed street manufacture — no branding, serial numbers, or manufacturing marks
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 4–5 street economy. Expensive enough to require purpose and savings, cheap enough to be semi-disposable. No corporate licensing, no warranty. Signals either technical skill or need for anonymity.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by field operators, street techs, break-in specialists, evidence-aware individuals, augmentation technicians working in ungoverned zones. The print-suppression lining marks the wearer as someone who moves through monitored spaces — corpo security, law enforcement surveillance, biometric scanners. Practical and paranoid in equal measure.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when fresh from manufacture — perfect micro-texture, unblemished grey. With use: micro-scratches accumulate on the textured outer surface from repeated climbing or contact; the inner lining remains chemically inert and unchanged. No visible staining or wear patterns; degradation is slow and invisible. Street gloves are typically replaced rather than repaired.
